title: Captured computation reaches the query state
statement: Let $S$ and $H$ be state sets, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $T$ be a natural number. Let $tm$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$, and let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes and state set $H$. Suppose there is a state map $e:S\to H$ whose image avoids the query state of $M$, and suppose that on every state in the image of $e$, $M$'s transition agrees with the capture transform of $tm$'s transition. For any oracle language $O$, Boolean words $pre,out_0$, and initial configuration $c_0$ of $tm$, if $tm$ is halted after $T$ steps from $c_0$, then there is a time $u\le T$ at which running $M$ with oracle $O$ from the capture image of $c_0$ reaches the capture image of $tm$'s configuration after $T$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A deterministic machine $tm$ with $k$ work tapes and states $S$
An oracle machine $M$ with $k$ ordinary work tapes and states $H$
An oracle language $O$ over Boolean words
A map $e:S\to H$ whose values are not $M$'s query state
Agreement of $M$'s transition on embedded states with the capture transform of $tm$'s transition
The run of $tm$ from $c_0$ is halted at time $T$
